rest.$description: Form field resting border — the boundary of a transparent-fill field, so a perceivable boundary (SC 1.4.11) at 4.5:1 against the darkest permissible ground (`background.secondary`), not the page alone

hover.$description: Form field hover border — four ramp steps stronger than rest, gated at 4.5:1 on the darkest permissible ground. A field draws no hover fill, so this border is its hover cue, with the pointer

placeholder.$description: Form field placeholder ink — a readable hint, 7:1 on the darkest permissible ground behind the transparent fill (not a sub-AA placeholder)
